audit.method: Read from the full term sheet by one AI reviewer, then checked against it twice by independent AI reviewers: first every line of the record against the document, then the document section by section against the record. Not signed off by a person. Every quote is looked up in the PDF text each time the tool runs.
audit.open_points:
Final record: C:\Users\AFarid\Documents\Hackathon\key_credit_terms\data\audited\seadrill_2026.json. Checker: structure OK; 45 quotes exact, 0 loose, 0 on another page, 0 missing. Every row of the two summary-terms slides (pp35-36, read from the page images as well as the dump) maps to a record row, and every figure in the record matches the Proposed column, with existing values correctly labelled. No wrong, transposed or misplaced figure was found. Searches of the dump for purpose, transfers, information undertakings, events of default, change of control, prepayment, governing law and extension options found nothing, so those rows stay not_stated. Only the Seadrill term sheet was used for content; the other audited records were read only to compare house style.

First auditor's doubts:
1. mandatory_prepayment: changed to not_stated (see changes).
2. fc_testing: by_reference kept.
3. fc_other 'Other: none': kept as stated. The 'Financial covenants' row has two bullets and nothing else is labelled a financial covenant. This file cannot exclude a further covenant in the separate term sheet or draft Amendment posted to SyndTrak.
4. Liens versus debt: kept. Lien-carrying baskets (Secured, Specified bilateral obligation, 2nd Lien Notes, Junior) are under Negative Pledge; Unsecured and General are under Permitted Financial Indebtedness, with pointers both ways. The slide heads all of these rows 'Permitted liens & indebtedness', so the split is a presentation choice. A reader who wants the $500m second lien and $250m junior caps in the debt row would have to move them, not copy them.
5. DACA quote: kept. It is verbatim from the dump and carries the 2.50x figure, but has 12 words of the Existing column in the middle. The note, which prints in the Word comment, explains this.
7. Ranking and Repayment: kept as derived points with the basis in brackets (p23 'First Lien RCF', p30 'RCF capacity', commitment fee, Scheduled Commitment Termination Date).
8. lender_commitments: three lines kept. The commitment deadline matches how the other lender-presentation records handle it. The JLA Fee is the only statement in the document tying a fee to a commitment size, and the template has no fee row.
9. Pricing and fees: left in notes, which reach the reader through the Word comments.

What the document cannot resolve:
- How the $250mm anti cash hoarding provision operates.
- What 'Specified bilateral obligation' ($100mm, existing $25mm) caps.
- What 'JLA' stands for, and whether the 'Seadrill Ltd 8.375% senior notes' are the $575mm Second Lien notes on p23.
- The stated maturity date of the Second Lien Notes, on which the springing maturity depends.
- Whether the $100mm accordion sits on top of the upsized $275mm.
- The meaning of the DACA bullet ('subject to Net Leverage of > 2.50x').
- 'Junior: Greater of (i) $250mm and (ii) Net Leverage <= 2.00x', which compares a dollar amount with a ratio.
- p23 shows $575mm of Second Lien notes against a $500mm permitted basket on p36.
- 'Any unsecured notes to mature 91 days after the Scheduled Commitment Termination Date' does not say 'no earlier than'.
- Seadrill Limited is identified as the top company only from the disclaimer and the financial statement headings; no jurisdiction is given.
All of these are recorded as worded.

doc.title: Lender Presentation
doc.notes: Seadrill lender presentation (38 slides) for a proposed amendment, upsize and extension of the existing first lien RCF of Seadrill Finance Limited. The terms are on the two 'Summary terms and conditions' slides (PDF pages 35-36), which show Existing and Proposed columns side by side; page 37 has the timeline and pages 23, 30 and 33 mention the RCF in passing. It is a summary only: many rows say 'Same as existing', and there is nothing on purpose, events of default, change of control, mandatory prepayment, transfers, information undertakings or conditions. A separate term sheet and a draft Amendment are to be posted on SyndTrak (page 37).
